title: LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio: Book-of-Business Minimum and Renewal Placement
content:
LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio is the book-of-business tier of the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy. It is written only while the customer holds at least 3 live LandlordGuard policies, the new policy included. A live policy is one whose status is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal, counted across the customer's dwelling policies as of the evaluation date.

## When the count is taken

- At binding, with the policy being bound counted in the total.
- Again on each Portfolio policy's renewal offer date.

## What follows from the count

| Count of live LandlordGuard policies on the date it is taken | At binding | On a Portfolio policy's renewal offer date |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | DP-3 Portfolio may be written | the policy continues on DP-3 Portfolio |
| fewer than 3 | DP-3 Portfolio is not written | the policy renews on LandlordGuard DP-3 Premier, with its indicated renewal premium rated for Premier and the renewal rate cap applied to it |

Nothing changes midterm: a drop in the count between renewal offer dates does not move a Portfolio policy off the tier during its term.

Claims history is judged per property, never pooled across the portfolio.

## Hypothetical cases

- A landlord with two live LandlordGuard policies binds a third building. Counting the new policy, the count is 3, which meets the minimum.
- A landlord's Portfolio book shrinks from four live policies to two when two buildings are sold and cancelled. On the next renewal offer date of each remaining Portfolio policy the count is 2, below 3, so each renews on LandlordGuard DP-3 Premier.
- The same drop happening midway through a term leaves the policy on DP-3 Portfolio until its renewal offer date.
